evals.prompt: Neo-Financial is trying to connect MSK in ca-central-1 to ClickHouse Cloud but getting timeouts. We've already researched the docs and found egress IPs and VPC endpoint options. Draft a concise Slack response for the customer explaining the networking options with doc links.
evals.expected_output: A concise Slack message (200-500 words) that leads with the answer, explains egress IPs and VPC endpoint options, includes doc links, and offers clear next steps

assertions.name: concise-length
assertions.text: Response is under 500 words (not counting SQL blocks)

assertions.name: leads-with-answer
assertions.text: First sentence or paragraph directly addresses the connectivity issue rather than starting with preamble

assertions.name: includes-next-steps
assertions.text: Response includes clear next steps or asks the customer for specific information

assertions.name: no-em-dashes
assertions.text: Response contains no em dash characters

assertions.name: no-bot-speak
assertions.text: Response does not use phrases like 'Certainly!', 'Great question!', 'I'd be happy to', 'Absolutely!'

assertions.name: customer-appropriate-tone
assertions.text: Tone is casual-professional, not overly formal or stiff. ClickHouse jargon is used naturally.

evals.prompt: We just got introduced to the Gitlab 'Knowledge graph' team. The account rep wants a quick internal Slack response explaining how ClickHouse might fit into their product and how to approach discovery. This is internal, not customer-facing.
evals.expected_output: A concise internal Slack response with ClickHouse fit analysis for the Knowledge Graph use case, discovery approach suggestions, and key questions to ask

assertions.name: internal-tone
assertions.text: Tone is appropriate for internal team communication - can be more direct and use internal context

assertions.name: discovery-guidance
assertions.text: Response includes specific questions to ask or discovery approach for the account rep

assertions.name: clickhouse-fit-analysis
assertions.text: Response explains how ClickHouse could fit the use case with specific technical reasoning

assertions.name: no-em-dashes
assertions.text: Response contains no em dash characters
